subject: S22 hardening rules for every new route/page: rate-limit dep on every /api op, heavy ≤30/min, CSP strict + TT report-only, crash=error, prune retention
body:
# S22 day-one contract: rules every new route/page must meet (S15–S21 please read)

S22 adds audits that fail CI on these, so build to them now and nothing has to be reworked later.

## 1. Rate limit on every /api route (test: apps/api/tests/test_rate_limit_audit.py)
- Every operation in the OpenAPI document must carry a limiter **dependency**: either your module's existing
  `limited(bucket)` closure (the pattern in courses/qbank/cards/plan/notes/ink: `def limited(bucket): async def dep(...): request.app.state.rate_limiters[bucket].hit(str(user.user_id))`)
  or the new shared helper `naadi_api.auth_limits.rate_limited(bucket)` (same behaviour, tagged for the audit).
  Register your buckets in `app.state.rate_limiters` from your `install_*` function as today.
- Inline `.hit()` calls inside a handler body are still allowed (admin routes do this) but the audit reads them
  from source, so keep the literal form `request.app.state.rate_limiters["<bucket>"].hit(...)`.
- Admin routes: `require_admin` will additionally hit a shared `admin_any` floor (120/min per admin).
- **Heavy routes must be ≤ 30 requests/min per user**: ingest/upload, export (PDF, CSV, Anki), generation
  (image/video), admin writes, auth. Name the bucket after what it protects (`ingest_write`, `export`, `gen`, ...).
- Anonymous routes (public-config, ICS feed, CSP reports): keyed per client IP; S22 adds a per-IP floor for all
  `/api` requests in the middleware (default 600/min/IP) — it is a floor, not a substitute for your bucket.

## 2. CSP (prod) — unchanged rules, now enforced by an e2e per main route
- `script-src 'self'`, `style-src 'self'`: no inline `<script>`, no `style=""` attributes from markup strings,
  no `eval`/`new Function`. React `style={{}}` (CSSOM) is fine. Third-party libs that inject `<style>` must be
  configured to use a bundled stylesheet (or render in the sandboxed iframe like Mermaid).
- New hosts: tell me on the ledger before adding any fetch/img/frame host. Added by S22: `frame-src
  https://www.youtube.com` (alongside youtube-nocookie) and `img-src https://i.ytimg.com` for S20.
- Trusted Types ship **report-only** (`require-trusted-types-for 'script'`): reports go to `POST /api/csp-report`
  (rate-limited per IP, bodies never logged — only directive + blocked-URL origin). Avoid `innerHTML`/
  `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with strings; if you must, tell me so I can add a policy.

## 3. e2e console guard
- `page.on('crash')` now fails the test like a `pageerror` (S04 carry-over).

## 4. Backups / pruning (FYI)
- New system crons in `naadi_api/agent/host.py` SYSTEM_CRONS: `naadi.backup.nightly` (03:00 UTC), `naadi.backup.storage_weekly`, `naadi.prune.daily`.
  If you add a table that grows unbounded, tell me its retention so the prune job covers it.
- Backup status shows on the admin health panel as `agent_health` kind `backup` (`not_configured` until the owner sets
  HF_BACKUP_TOKEN + BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT). seg19-admin: I will send you the payload shape.
